objective: Explore toward a visible passage or useful target using short moves, react to hazards, and record what controls and barriers are actually observed. Escalate if unclear. Completion requires runtime evidence; a changed image alone is not progress.

awareness.basis: Configured starting hypothesis from game/source ontology, not a runtime physics measurement

actions.description: Release buttons for 24 frames; observe a transition or cooldown
Try moving right toward a visible passage or target for 12 frames
Try moving left for 12 frames, including avoiding a hazard or testing another route
Try A briefly as the configured jump control; verify its actual effect
Try B briefly as the configured attack control; verify its actual effect
Try moving right while pressing A for 12 frames; reobserve before continuing
Try UP briefly when an observed passage or interaction suggests it
